_help.stat: One of: pass_yds, pass_td, rush_yds, rec_yds, rec
_help.line: The number to reach. A '30+' prop is line: 30 and hits at >= 30.
_help.team: Display hint only, used for kickoff info before a game starts. The real team is taken from the box score once the game is live, so a wrong hint here cannot break matching.
_help.aliases: Optional extra spellings to match against ESPN's athlete names.
_help.placeholder: Set true for a leg you haven't filled in yet. It is never scored, and the slip can't read as WON while one is present.
